craft_notes: Sthāyin: fed-core (sense-goddesses feeding bliss). Rows: row 3 (honor→praise; shared line with L3 kept deliberately — the list IS the music). Close: praise. Rejected: reordering feast-goddesses — killed: Sanskrit order kept (feasts first, feeders second); 'conscious' for cinmaya — killed: consciousness-made kept (maya as made-of, exact).

lines: With their own sense-feasts the sense-goddesses ever honor
in the heart-lotus — whom, him, consciousness-made bliss-Bhairava, praise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ātmīyaviṣayabhogairindriyadevyaḥ sadā hṛdambhoje | abhipūjayanti yaṃ taṃ cinmayamānandabhairavaṃ vande

reads_against.argmap: Who dwells in the heart? → Ānanda-Bhairava, ever-blissful core (cinmaya, Cakreśvara seat), fed by sense-goddesses; pleasure, pain, sorrow all rendered as offerings.
c1_essence: Sense-goddesses feast the heart-lotus: consciousness-made bliss-Bhairava at the core.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
